# https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/info

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/info

This method returns the authenticated record user.
Method Syntax

```php
$db->info()
```

###  Example usage[](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php/v1/methods/info#example-usage)

```php
$user = $db->info();
```
